decisions.reason: As a mechanical water-control product, the spring-controlled flap weir fits closely with an established German machinery firm's existing design, production, and application knowledge, so early market learning is likely to improve rather than terminate it.

The energy management system is more software- and systems-integration-intensive than the firm's core machinery base, and after the apparent discontinuation of several 2023 digital offerings, management would be more likely to redeploy resources unless strong customer uptake becomes visible quickly.

The overflow flap gate is strongly aligned with the firm's core hydraulic and mechanical capabilities, and its prominent standalone presentation on the website suggests commitment and sufficient absorptive capacity to refine and commercialise it further.
